story.title: ComfyUI raises $30M at $500M valuation as creators demand more control over AI-generated media
story.summary: ComfyUI, a platform that gives creators granular control over AI-generated image, video, and audio output, has raised $30 million in new funding at a $500 million valuation. The round signals growing investor conviction that professional and semi-professional creators want fine-grained tools rather than fully automated black-box AI generators. ComfyUI's node-based workflow system has attracted a large open-source community before this funding round. The company plans to use the capital to expand its tooling and enterprise offering.
